target: Full arbitrary-dimension QFORM bounded-density conjecture with independent scalar densities <=1 and at least three eigenvalues of modulus >=1.

mathematical_premises.scope: Fixed physical 3x2 rank-two cross block plus nonzero transverse curvature; exact Plancherel and scalar weighted gate.
Rank-k linear image density <=2^(k/2)/sqrt(det(TT^T)); used at k=2.

partner_result_applied.application: Applied its diffuse rank-two plus dependence-safe physical square theorem to A_m=[1] direct_sum J_m/m direct_sum (-J_m/m), obtaining the uniform bound <7.692.

new_result.statement: For a physical triple I and arbitrary disjoint bank K with rank A[I,K]=2, nonzero transverse curvature a, and Delta_2=sqrt(pdet(MM^T)), the full coupled Q has continuous density bounded by 1/pi+4sqrt(2)pi^(1/3)Delta_2^(-1/2)max(3^(1/4),|a|^(-1/4)).

candidate_refuted.statement: Three large eigenvalues force one physical triple with a uniformly good aggregate rank-two crossbank gate.
candidate_refuted.witness: A_m=[1] direct_sum J_m/m direct_sum (-J_m/m): for the natural rank-two triple, a=1 and Delta_2=(m-1)/m^2, so the gate cost grows like sqrt(m).
candidate_refuted.note: This does not refute QFORM; the named partner diffuse theorem controls the same family uniformly.
